So it is with the mythical Silk-steel armours, woven from strands of silk taken from the dark brood of Shelob and her ilk, wound with threads of mithril and forged into the steel itself to craft armour of surpassing strength and lightness. Would that all such workings of the enemy could come to such elegant ends.
